_about: The shapes a decision model's reply takes through an OpenAI-compatible chat completion asked for the typed JSON the decision seat reads (participants/decide.ts, llm/decide-openrouter.ts). These are the SHAPES the seat must read, written by hand — NOT recorded from any decision model: what typesafe/jev-* returns on OpenRouter is unverified (PLAN-IPAD-NOTES §3). The envelope is OpenRouter's, as in replies.json; `content` is what the seat is asked to write. Read by the core tests and by the e2e stub (e2e/servers.mjs), never by the page.

prose.content: I think it is a molecule, probably.
